title: DashboardSchema.columns 的说明写“默认 12”，渲染器实际按内容推断 4 或 12
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a shipped-text defect, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7126155706, item 2). Source: L2 record 7126124909 on PR #36883 (#36816). It is read from code and is older than that PR.

## What happens

The `DashboardSchema.columns` describe says "(default 12)". The renderer does not default to 12. When `columns` is absent, `DashboardRenderer.tsx` (~389–413, main 151e8123) infers 4 or 12 from the widgets. A builder, or an AI reading the describe, expects a 12-column grid and gets 4.

reach: read from code. A describe is what AI copies into what it writes, so this reaches "builders, often".

## Expected

The describe states what the renderer does. The runtime is the source of truth.

## Acceptance

- The `columns` describe names the inference: absent means 4 or 12, inferred from the widgets, with the rule in one clause.
- The generated docs and JSON schema, and any skill or docs page that repeats "default 12", follow the new wording.
- No runtime change.

Dedupe: open issues for `DashboardSchema.columns` and "default 12" return none.
